english.title: Solemnize marriage under Superintendent Registrar's certificate on approved premises in absence of district registrar
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO MARRIAGE..) on approved premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF PREMISES..) in pursuance of section 26(1)(bb) of the Marriage Act 1949 in the absence of a registrar of **(..SPECIFY REGISTRATION DISTRICT..), the registration district in which the premises were situated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2)(cc) of the Marriage Act 1949.
